It called for a comprehensive investigation came following the arrest of Alexandros Paporakis in Illinois, accused of plotting a mass shooting driven at a Hindu temple in Aurora, Illinois. Authorities uncovered alarming evidence tied to extremist views at his residence, leading the MEA to demand justice and advocate for community safety measures.

title: Chuck Feeney’s $350m gift helped build Cornell Tech campus in New York
description: In 2011, Chuck Feeney, a notable billionaire, pledged an impressive $350 million to create Cornell Tech in New York City. This generous gesture was pivotal in clinching a contest for a new technology campus. Launched in phases starting in 2017, this initiative integrates academic research with industry collaboration. Feeney believed in living philanthropy, contributing nearly $1 billion to Cornell and global causes throughout his life.

title: London’s oldest restaurant gets National Trust protection
description: A historic restaurant in London, renowned for its royal visitors and celebrity clientele over the past 228 years, has been gifted to a conservation organization to ensure its legacy. The donation encompasses the building alongside valuable memorabilia to support conservation initiatives. Operations of the restaurant will persist, securing jobs for its staff while marking a paramount effort in safeguarding this cultural icon for future generations.

title: Actor Imran Khan to move Bombay HC against order to leave India
description: Actor Imran Khan has approached the Bombay High Court against an order for his deportation from India. The order was issued after his participation in a protest supporting the Cockroach Janata Party. BJP leader Kirit Somaiya filed a complaint to the Mumbai Police regarding Khan’s actions. As an Overseas Citizen of India, Khan is subject to specific rules and regulations.

title: ‘Consistent with good practices’: IMF defends India's revised GDP calculation
description: The International Monetary Fund has recognized India's updated approach to measuring gross domestic product, commending the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation for enhancing GDP metrics. Amid strong economic performance and rising domestic demand, the IMF has also revised its growth predictions for India. Currency fluctuations were acknowledged; however, Srinivasan clarified they do not indicate any economic frailty.

title: PM Modi inaugurates Rs 3,350 cr projects in Ladakh, including new Leh airport terminal
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi recently launched five pivotal projects in Ladakh aimed at advancing airport facilities and improving road connectivity. These projects feature a new terminal at Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport and the creation of the Nimmu-Padum-Darcha Road. The Hanu Hydroelectric Project will foster renewable energy, supplemented by a Conservation Park to preserve historic artifacts.

title: Pakistan tests Fatah-II ballistic missile, same type intercepted during Operation Sindoor
description: Pakistan's Army conducted a test launch of the Fatah-2 Extended Range hypersonic ballistic missile, enhancing its military capabilities. This missile provides improved precision and the ability to outmaneuver enemy defenses during engagements. The test is significant as it follows India's recent operations targeting threats within Pakistan's territory. The development of this missile is part of an evolving missile strategy amid regional military tensions.

title: Pennsylvania court overturns $28,000 tax sale of home over notice failures
description: A Pennsylvania man who owned a Chester home for 10 years saw it sold for $28,000 at a tax sale over unpaid property taxes, with an upset price of $5,741. On October 13, 2026, the Commonwealth Court of Pennsylvania overturned the sale, ruling that officials had failed to make reasonable efforts to notify him after a notice was returned unclaimed.

title: Meta AI head Alexandr Wang praises Mark Zuckerberg leaving Meta CEO flattered
description: Alexandr Wang recently shared his admiration for Mark Zuckerberg, highlighting his exceptional leadership and decision-making skills. Wang pointed out Zuckerberg's readiness to make bold strategic changes grounded in deep convictions, a trait that sets him apart in the tech world. Initially taken aback, Wang grew to respect Zuckerberg's approach. In a lighthearted exchange, Zuckerberg acknowledged the compliment, showcasing Meta's focus on decisive executive actions.

title: ‘I’ll commit suicide’: Absconding model Shraddha Dubey releases video in murder case
description: Shraddha Dubey claims she dated Shiva Sharma for two months before his death from a fall. Dubey alleges Sharma was deeply in debt and threatened suicide if he could not repay loans. Following Sharma's death, his mother filed a police complaint accusing Dubey and others of murder. The Lucknow Police are investigating the claims and have offered a reward for information on Dubey.

title: Bihar man, Russian woman’s viral love story turns out fake - what really happened
description: A love story claiming a Russian woman traveled to Bihar to marry a local man has been debunked. The video featured a British NGO representative, Andrea Connolly, visiting for social initiatives in Purnia. The man in the footage, Namit, was misidentified as Rahul from Bhagalpur, where the love story originated. Local organizations are considering legal action against misinformation and media outlets for lack of verification.

title: 'No replacement for Bumrah': Sanju Samson's big statement after India's defeat
description: Sanju Samson acknowledges Jasprit Bumrah's unique talent while highlighting the potential of younger bowlers like Arshdeep Singh and Prince Yadav. He mentions the challenges faced by India's bowlers in the ongoing T20I series against West Indies. Samson praises West Indies captain Shai Hope for his impressive form throughout the series. He expresses confidence in Abhishek Sharma and Ishan Kishan despite the top order's recent struggles.

title: Nando’s billionaire revealed as buyer of A$17.4m North Bondi beach house
description: A beach house located on the Ben Buckler headland has been sold for A$17.4 million. Richard Enthoven, the owner of Nando's, and his wife bought the property recently. This four-bedroom home is designed for comfortable coastal living and features luxurious amenities throughout. The sale was completed on June 20, highlighting the property's appeal and the buyers' interests.

title: Arizona man builds backyard railway with nearly 4,000 feet of track
description: Arizona businessman Dennis Sirrine spent years and hundreds of thousands of dollars transforming his backyard into one of America's largest private garden railways. Started in 2004, the Palo Verde & Southwestern Railroad featured nearly 4,000 feet of track, hundreds of model train cars, artificial mountains and lakes. The project involved extensive construction, repeated rebuilding and a specially designed operating system.

title: Paid Rs 1.5 lakh for a Poland job that never came; firm ordered to pay Rs 1.75 lakh
description: A district consumer commission in Kerala has directed Global Pass to refund Rs 1.5 lakh to Akash. Akash had paid the amount for a promised job in Poland which was never arranged. The commission found the firm guilty of deficiency in service and unfair trade practices. It also ordered compensation and litigation costs to be paid to Akash. The consultancy must comply within 45 days or face additional penalties.

title: 'Big items are done': Sergio Gor gives update on India-US trade deal
description: In a recent statement, US Ambassador Sergio Gor revealed that substantial progress has been made in the negotiations for a trade deal between India and the US. He pointed out that many crucial items on their agenda have been successfully addressed. Gor also underscored the vast potential for American businesses to thrive in India's diverse market, assuring that current dialogues about Russian sanctions are not aimed at India.

title: Shakira gave $3.68m for Cartagena school now serving over 1,000 children a year

Each year, this invaluable institution serves over 1,000 students, with a capacity to educate 1,700. Shakira's foundation has generously funded approximately $3.68 million of the total $8 million needed for construction.

Meanwhile, the BJP has rallied to support Ram, claiming the opposition is merely inflating tensions.
